verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Devin publishes a live llms.txt at docs.devin.ai (HTTP 200), organized into sectioned per-area markdown bundles such as Desktop and API. Individual doc pages are also served as raw .md, each with a header telling agents to fetch the llms.txt index, and many cited pages are .md URLs. Missing for 10: an independent or community report of agents actually consuming these docs, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found (all candidate paths 404) to round out the agent-oriented docs.
